name: Cryo Station
pitch: A frozen research outpost where the floor fights you as much as the swarm: ice sheets, cryo vents and the first egg fields.

theme.floor: White/light grey plates #d9dee3 with the existing blue zones #4aa3df; ice sheets #cfe9f7 (high gloss)
theme.walls: Existing white/grey blocks #eef1f4 with pale blue trim #9cc8e6
theme.lighting: Key light cold white #e8f4ff, intensity 1.1, 50 deg from the top-left; ambient #a9c3d6 at 0.45
theme.signature_detail: Slow snow particles drifting across the camera; frost breath puffs from vents; the blue zones glow faintly
theme.audio: Wind howl bed, metal creaks, vents hissing on their rhythm

signature: The tutorial zone, with one twist per floor. Ice makes you commit to a direction, so kiting turns into wide arcs and Drones skid past you. Cryo vents freeze anything in them for a moment, and a frozen enemy takes +50% damage, so the best play is to pull the pack through a vent column on its warning beat. Egg fields teach the low-priority target rule: clear them early or they hatch behind you.

floors.events: Wave 3 adds the two Spitters and a late Tick group (enemies doc). No vents yet: the vent columns stay idle with a faint frost so the player sees them before they matter.
Two egg fields between the nests. Vents switch on (cryo skin). First Leapers stalk on the ice: pounces slide an extra 3 m there.
The ring sits on the central ice sheet, ringed by four vents. At 50% progress all eggs on the floor hatch (HATCH_ALL, 3 s wobble).
Whiteout: fog density doubles at 20 s for 10 s (fog end 30 m). The Bloater arrives at 25 s.
Arena with four cryo vents in a diamond. Luring the boss through an erupting vent freezes it for 2 s (boss rule) and shows the 'FROZEN +50%' hint.

boss.name: Gravid Bloater (from enemies-and-powerups.md)
boss.body: Keeps today's giant elite Bloater fight as the tutorial boss. Zone twist: the arena's vents freeze it for 2 s (once per vent per 15 s), and its mini Drones slide on the ice ring around the centre. Teaches 'use the map against the boss' before every later zone asks for it.
boss.look: Existing giant Bloater (6x HP) with frost-white rim tint #dff3ff on its pus material.

modifiers: Deep Freeze: ice covers 50% more floor (every '.' next to an 'i' becomes ice).
Hatchery: every egg field has +2 clusters and hatches 1 s faster.
Blizzard: whiteout fog all run; enemies beyond 12 m show only eye glints.
Acid Rain (existing briefing placeholder): ACID_RAIN pulses, blue zones count as COVER.

rewards.first_clear: Cryo Rounds power-up joins the drop pool in every zone.
rewards.replay: Cheapest zone to farm Credits; Hot Zone appears here most often for new players.

stars.3: Clear without being hit by a Leaper pounce.
stars.bonus: Freeze 25 enemies with cryo vents in one run.

layout_notes.cryo-a: Cold Storage. Open hall with two ice lanes and a vent column on each side of the central block.
layout_notes.cryo-b: Egg Labs. Three nests in the corners of a ring corridor; egg fields guard the shortcuts.
layout_notes.cryo-c: Thaw Pool. HOLD ring on a central ice sheet with four vents around it.
layout_notes.cryo-boss: Reactor Ring. Open arena, ice ring, four vents in a diamond, crates as Leaper-bait cover.

name: Evac Deck
pitch: The Escape Test map grown into a zone: a burning evacuation deck of sealed rooms, hijacked turrets and laser fences between you and the last shuttle.

theme.floor: Manuel's approved WORN plates tile (floor_c2_worn, ~4 m per tile) with the dirt layer
theme.walls: Charcoal grey #3a3d42 with yellow caps #f2c230 and navy trim #1f2f4f (escape_a_overview concept)
theme.lighting: Key light warm white #fff1dc 0.9 from top-right; red alarm point lights #ff2a2a pulsing 0.5 Hz in every sealed room
theme.signature_detail: Existing blast doors with their seal/clear sequences; sparking ceiling cables (spark particles dropping from 4 m); evac klaxon on every seal
theme.audio: Klaxon on seal, Manuel's door takes, distant shuttle engines spooling up as the run progresses

signature: Rooms seal behind you, so every fight is a locked box and the question is what you bring into it. Neutral turrets sit in most rooms: capturing one takes 2.5 s of standing still in the open, then it pulls half the swarm off you. Laser fences cut rooms into corridors that open and close on a 5/3 s beat, so you learn to time crossings and to bait Leapers into live fences.

floors.events: Room 2 holds the first turret; a hint tells the player to stand on its ring. Room 3's door needs a 4.5 s hack while the Ticks come through the door before it seals.

floors.params: 45 s, shuttle fuel pump on G
floors.events: Four turrets in the corners. The two fence pairs (top and bottom) cut the spawn lanes on their cycle, so packs arrive in pulses. At 30 s both Carapaces enter from opposite sides.
Room 2 is a laser-fence maze; the hack terminal for its exit sits between two fences, so the hack is timed against the fence beat.
Lockdown: fences stay on 8 s / off 2 s, turrets recapture in 1.5 s. The med station opens at 25 s.
Shuttle bay. Two turrets, four cycling fence posts and crate stacks that break when the boss pounces into them.

boss.name: Razorback (alpha Leaper)
boss.body: HP 120 RH. Phase 1 (100-60%): chain pounce, two red arrows shown one after the other (0.6 s apart) so you dodge twice; if a pounce ends in a crate stack it breaks the crates and is stunned 2.5 s (take +50% damage). Phase 2 (60-25%): calls 2 Leapers every 12 s and pounces three times in a chain; the fences start cycling, and a pounce that crosses a live fence stuns it 3 s and burns 8 RH. Phase 3 (25-0%): enraged, arrows lock 0.3 s sooner and it tail-swipes (120 degree cone, 0.6 s red flash, 20 HP) after every landing. Captured turrets always target it.
boss.look: Leaper model at 2.2x, crimson #8f1d1d body with a bone-white crest #e8e0d0 (emissive edge), red eye glow; screech pitched down 30%.

modifiers: Power Surge: fences cycle twice as fast.
Abandoned Armoury: turrets fire 50% faster but last only 15 s.
Sealed Tight: doors need a hack even after the room is cleared (2.5 s).
Tick Infestation: every Drone group brings 3 Ticks.

rewards.first_clear: Sentry Drone power-up joins the drop pool; turrets in every later zone capture 20% faster.
rewards.replay: Best time board: the escape floors reward speed, and the end screen shows best time as the Escape Test does today.

stars.3: Finish both ESCAPE floors in under 90 s each.
stars.bonus: Clear with every turret in the zone captured at least once.

layout_notes.evac-a: Four-room loop: start room top-left, door right, door down, door left into the lift room. The turret sits in room 2.
layout_notes.evac-b: Shuttle pad. Fuel pump G in a striped box, fence pairs cutting the top and bottom spawn lanes, four corner turrets.
layout_notes.evac-c: Fence Run. Three rooms left to right; the middle one is a laser-fence maze.
layout_notes.evac-boss: Shuttle Bay. Open bay with crate stacks as pounce bait, two turrets, four fence posts in the middle.

name: Kessler Refinery
pitch: A slag refinery still running on autopilot: conveyor belts carry you and the swarm toward molten channels and hydraulic presses.

theme.floor: Dark steel plates #3b3f45 with yellow-black hazard stripes at belt edges
theme.walls: Rust-brown blocks #6b4a33 with grey steel caps #7d8288
theme.lighting: Low key light #ffd8b0 0.7 from the left; orange point lights #ff6a1a along every slag channel; flicker on presses
theme.fog: Warm brown #3a2a20, linear 18-50 m, plus a heat-haze screen distortion near slag (optional, cut on low quality)
theme.signature_detail: Ember particles rising from the slag, sparks from the presses, steam bursts from vents
theme.audio: Belt rumble (pitch follows belt speed), press slams, slag bubbling

signature: The floor moves. Belts give you free speed one way and make you fight to go the other, and they carry the swarm the same way, so a belt that ends in slag is a kill lane: stand beyond it and let the auto-fire shove pack slide in. Presses slam on the striped cells on a fixed beat (STRIKE fixed mode: a circle on every 'y' cell, every 4 s), so crossing a belt is a timing puzzle. The swarm's flow field avoids slag, so it funnels through predictable crossings you can hold.

floors.events: Teaches the kill lane: the north-running belt on the left feeds straight into the slag channel. Wave 2 spawns right on that belt.
The ring sits inside a conveyor loop, so the swarm is carried around you; leaving and re-entering costs a belt crossing. Vents on both flanks pulse steam (VENT, steam skin).
Nests sit on islands cut off by slag; one-way belts are the bridges, so each nest is a commitment. A Shrieker guards the last nest.
Every 12 s every belt reverses (chevrons flash 1.5 s first). The kill lane flips into a launch lane that throws enemies at you.
Smelting floor: four slag pools, two press rows. The boss can be dunked.

boss.name: Slagback (giant Carapace)
boss.body: HP 160 RH, armoured front (15% damage, as the Carapace). Phase 1: Carapace charge (yellow lane, 0.9 s windup) twice per cycle; baiting it into a slag pool deals 15% of its max HP, ignites it for 4 s and strips its front armour for 6 s (glowing white). Phase 2 (60%): it trails molten slag (SPREAD fire skin on its path, 6 s life) and the presses double speed. Phase 3 (25%): it slams the floor, lifting 3 random STRIKE circles around you on every charge recovery. A charge through a press cell while the press falls stuns it 3 s.
boss.look: Carapace look (Bloater model 0.75x squashed) at 2.4x scale, black #1d1d1f shell with glowing orange cracks #ff6a1a (emissive), ember particles; sparks when bullets hit the front.

modifiers: Overdrive: belts run at 5 m/s.
Heat Wave: slag channels widen by one cell on floors 3-5.
Rolling Stock: barrels ride the belts and explode on contact.
Press Gang: presses on every belt, every 3 s.

rewards.first_clear: Overcharge power-up joins the drop pool.
rewards.replay: Best zone to farm Weapon Parts (x1.25 Weapon Parts here).

stars.3: Dunk Slagback in slag three times.
stars.bonus: Kill 40 enemies with slag, presses or belts in one run.

layout_notes.kess-a: Belt Hall. A slag channel splits the hall; a south-running belt is the main bridge, a north belt on the left is the kill lane.
layout_notes.kess-b: Loop Control. HOLD ring inside a conveyor loop, slag at the bottom corners.
layout_notes.kess-c: Slag Islands. Three nests on islands separated by slag; one-way belts and two narrow bridges connect them.
layout_notes.kess-boss: Smelting Floor. Four slag pools, two press rows on the striped cells, vents on the sides.

name: Verdant Colony
pitch: A farming dome gone feral: hedgerows you can shoot over but not walk through, spore pods that hide the swarm, and the first hive creep crawling between the crops.

theme.floor: Dark soil #4a3b2a in crop beds, mossy green plates #5f7a45 in the paths
theme.walls: Greenhouse panels: pale white-green blocks #dfe8dc at 0.85 opacity look (solid colour, bright rim), green steel caps #3f5a3a
theme.lighting: Warm sun #ffe6a8 1.2 from high top-left through the dome; green bounce ambient #9fbf7a 0.5
theme.signature_detail: Pollen motes (dust particles tinted gold), sprinkler mist arcs on the blue zones, crop rows drawn as railings tinted green
theme.audio: Insects and dripping water, wet squelch on creep, pods inflating with a rubbery creak

signature: Crop hedges ('r', green) block walking but not bullets, so you fight across rows and the swarm has to go around them, which strings packs out into lines. Spore clouds hide whole packs: you learn to shoot pods before you walk past them. Creep appears for the first time and the BURN objective teaches that dashing through creep scorches it.

floors.events: Spitters lob over the hedgerows. Four spore pods along the paths puff on their 15 s beat.
A creep bloom covers the greenhouse; two nests feed it. Hint on floor start: 'Dash through creep to burn it'. Killing a nest makes its creep recede, which is the efficient route.
Each nest is ringed by egg clusters that hatch when you get close (EGGS).
Bloom: every pod on the floor puffs at the same moment every 15 s, blanking the map for 8 s; the Shrieker hides inside the clouds.
Central garden. The boss plants pods as it walks.

boss.name: Mother Bloom
boss.body: HP 170 RH. A walking garden. Phase 1: walks a slow figure-eight and plants a Spore Pod every 8 s; it regenerates 2% HP/s while standing on creep, and creep spreads from its feet (SPREAD creep, tick 1.5 s), so burning its trail is the real damage race. Phase 2 (60%): spore burst every 10 s, a 6 m cloud around itself (1.5 s inflate telegraph); inside the cloud only its eyes show. Phase 3 (30%): roots itself in the centre (immune to knockback), sends creep tendrils along the four paths and hatches all egg clusters; destroying the four nearest pods makes it wilt for 5 s (takes double damage).
boss.look: Bloater model at 2.6x, moss green #5c7a3a skin with pale yellow pus sacs #d8e070 (the Bloater pus material recoloured), 6 Spore Pod meshes parented on its back that inflate on the spore telegraph.

modifiers: Overgrowth: creep starts on 25% of every floor.
Pollen Storm: spore clouds last 12 s.
Fertile Soil: egg clusters respawn 30 s after being destroyed.
Sprinklers: blue zones become shallow WATER (slows, puts out creep).

rewards.first_clear: Incendiary Rounds power-up joins the drop pool (it burns creep, which every hive zone rewards).
rewards.replay: Biomass x1.2 in this zone: the best place to push level-up cards and test evolutions.

stars.3: Beat Mother Bloom without letting her regenerate on creep for more than 5 s total.
stars.bonus: Destroy 30 Spore Pods before they puff.

layout_notes.verd-a: Crop Rows. Long green hedgerows split the field into lanes; pods sit at lane ends.
layout_notes.verd-b: Greenhouse. Creep bloom in the middle beds fed by two nests; paths around the edge.
layout_notes.verd-c: Nest Orchard. Three nests in walled gardens, each ringed by eggs.
layout_notes.verd-boss: Central Garden. Four paths into a round bed; pods and eggs along the paths.

name: Blackout Labs
pitch: A research wing with the power cut: you see only what your light, your flares and the pylons you relight can reach, and something in the dark is hunting you.

theme.floor: Clean lab tiles #c9ced4 (reads mid-grey in the dark) with black seams; grates #555b62
theme.walls: White lab blocks #eef1f4 with red emergency strips #ff2a2a (emissive, 0.3)
theme.lighting: Directional light 8%, ambient 10% blue-black #0b0f18; hero light 5.5 m cool white #dfe9ff; red emergency strips give silhouettes
theme.signature_detail: Flickering ceiling panels (a few point lights that strobe at random), dust in the hero's light cone, red eye glints in the dark
theme.audio: Generator hum that drops out, breathing and skittering in the dark, Geiger-like tick when an unlit enemy is within 6 m

signature: Auto-fire only targets enemies that are lit, so light is your range. Flares (3 charges, right-thumb button) light 7 m for 12 s and expose enemies (+20% damage); pylons are permanent but cost 1.5 s of standing still. Relighting the floor through relays is the objective on two floors. Electrified grates are a killing floor for the swarm, and a breaker can switch them off when they hurt you more than them. Stalkers (enemies doc) debut here, invisible even in light until hit.

floors.events: Half-lit: dark 'd' rooms on both wings. First flare cache by the spawn with a hint. Spitter globs glow green in the dark, so they read.
Floor fully dark. Relay 1 lights the west wing, relay 2 the east wing, relay 3 powers the grates (they start cycling) and ends the floor. Breaker by relay 3.
Full dark, 6 unlit pylons and 2 flare caches. Every 15 s a power surge lights the whole floor for 1 s (flash), showing every enemy at once.
Same wing, lights back off, nests grown where the relays were. Grates on from the start; the breaker is now a choice.
Containment hall. Four pylons, grates around the centre, two breakers.

boss.name: Subject Zero
boss.body: HP 150 RH. An albino Leaper the lab was studying. It is invisible outside light (eye glints only) and takes double damage while exposed by a flare or pylon. Phase 1: stalks and pounces from the dark (its red arrow is the only warning; the arrow is always visible). Phase 2 (60%): smashes a lit pylon every 15 s (relight it in 1.5 s) and spawns 2 Stalkers. Phase 3 (30%): kills the lights entirely (pylons off, flares refill to 3) and pounces in a chain of three; luring a pounce onto a live grate stuns it 3 s and lights it up (it glows blue while stunned).
boss.look: Leaper model at 2.0x, bone white #f2efe8 with no texture detail, pale pink emissive eyes, bright cyan sparks when on a grate.

modifiers: Dead Batteries: hero light radius 4 m.
Flare Shortage: 1 flare charge, caches give 1.
Surge: grates on 2.4 s each cycle.
Night Shift: every Drone group includes a Stalker.

rewards.first_clear: Flare Pack: every later dark floor starts with 4 flares instead of 3.
rewards.replay: Act I finale: its first clear opens Act II.

stars.bonus: Clear while using at most 4 flares.

layout_notes.black-a: Two Wings. Lit central atrium, dark wings ('d') on both sides with a flare cache by the spawn.
layout_notes.black-b: Relay Wing. Three relays spaced around a U-shaped corridor; grates across the main corridor; breaker next to relay 3.
layout_notes.black-c: Server Hall. Open dark hall with server rows (B), six pylons and two flare caches.
layout_notes.black-boss: Containment. Grate cross in the middle, four pylons at the corners of the cross, two breakers.

name: Drowned City
pitch: A flooded colony district where the tide is the clock: water slows you, live cables turn it into a trap, and on one floor a flood surge chases you to the lift.

theme.floor: Wet asphalt #2e3338 with lane paint #c9b458; shallow water #2a5d7a translucent over it
theme.walls: Grey-blue concrete blocks #5a6670 with algae-green bases #3e5a44; broken neon signs as emissive strips (cyan #3fe0ff, pink #ff4fa3)
theme.lighting: Overcast key light #b8c8d8 0.6 from the top; neon point lights reflected in the water
theme.fog: Grey-blue #6f8291, exponential 0.025, plus light rain particles
theme.signature_detail: Rain streaks, ripples around every moving unit, neon reflections, floating barrels that bob
theme.audio: Rain on metal, water sloshing that rises with depth, crackle when cables are live

signature: Water slows you (shallow -20%, deep -45%) but dash is never slowed, so every fight becomes a question of where the dry ground is. Floods spread on a 20 s pulse; pumps drain them. Grates that touch water electrify the whole connected pool on their beat, which is the best killing tool in the zone and the biggest danger to you. The OUTRUN floor debuts here: a flood surge sweeps the map and you race it to the lift.

floors.events: Shallow streets, dry pavements. One live cable (grate) in the main street pool: the first wave walks into it to show what it does.
Each pump (R, 3 s) drains a third of the flood. The floor floods every 20 s until all three run. Burrowers cannot surface in water, so they surface on the dry ground you need.

floors.params: flood surge west to east, 1.2 m/s
floors.events: Surge starts behind the spawn after 5 s. Two bulkhead valves (R) pause it 4 s. Enemies spawn ahead of you and ride the surge.
The ring is on a dry plaza; the water around it rises every 15 s (deep from 20 s). Breaker K kills the grates if you need the plaza edges safe.
Sunken square with two deep pools and grates on their rims. The boss swims.

boss.name: Tidecaller
boss.body: HP 180 RH. Travels submerged in deep water (untargetable, a wake trail shows where it is) and surfaces to attack. Phase 1: surfaces under you with a Burrower-style ring (2.2 m, 1.0 s warning) when you stand in water, then stays up 3 s. Phase 2 (60%): floods the square every 12 s (water +1 depth step); spits Spitter globs from the pools. Phase 3 (30%): whips a 10 m water lash in a line (red lane 0.8 s). Counter: the two pool terminals (R) switch the grates to 'always on' for 5 s; if Tidecaller is submerged in an electrified pool it is forced up, stunned 3 s and takes 10% max HP.
boss.look: Leaper model at 2.5x with the legs hidden under the water plane, sea-green #2f6f62 skin, cyan emissive gill slits #5fd8ff, water-splash particles (smoke recoloured white-blue) on surfacing.

modifiers: High Tide: every 'w' starts deep.
Storm: lightning STRIKE every 9 s (COVER: none, so keep moving).
Short Circuit: grates cycle at random intervals.
Riptide: deep water pushes 1.5 m/s toward the nearest pool.

rewards.first_clear: Bulwark power-up joins the drop pool; Cryo Rounds now also freeze water cells for 4 s (walkable at full speed).
rewards.replay: Weekly bounty source: OUTRUN best time leaderboard per tier.

stars.3: Finish the OUTRUN floor without the surge touching you.

layout_notes.drown-a: Flooded Avenue. A main street pool with one live cable, dry pavements on both sides, raised blue-zone rooftops (dry, ~) in the corners.
layout_notes.drown-b: Pump Station. Three pumps around a flooded basin with grates on the basin rim.
layout_notes.drown-c: Canal Run. Long west-to-east canal street for the surge; two bulkhead valves on the way; lift at the east end.
layout_notes.drown-d: Plaza Island. Dry plaza ring in the middle, water all around, breaker on the south edge.
layout_notes.drown-boss: Sunken Square. Two deep pools with grates on the rims and a pool terminal beside each.

name: Hadley Cargo Port
pitch: A storm-lashed container terminal still running on autopilot: belts herd the swarm, cranes drop steel boxes that rebuild the map mid-fight, and the cargo lifts throw you between split decks.

theme.floor: Wet asphalt #2f3236 with faded yellow lane paint #d9b23a, hazard stripes at every belt end; belts dark rubber #2b2b2e with yellow chevrons
theme.walls: Stacked cargo crates (existing model) recoloured per stack: rust red #8a3324, Hadley teal #1f7a7a, faded orange #c4642a; quay walls grey concrete #6d7177
theme.lighting: Key light sodium orange #ffb35c, intensity 0.95, 35 deg low from the right (dock floodlights); ambient #3a4656 at 0.4; red crane warning lamps (point lights #ff3b2f, 4 m) blinking 1 Hz on each crane mast
theme.signature_detail: Crane shadows (a long dark box decal) sweep across the floor 3 s before a container drops, so the threat reads from anywhere on screen; spray particles drift in from the quay edge
theme.audio: Rain on steel, belt rumble, crane motor whine rising before each drop, a ship horn on wave start, container clang on landing

signature: The port is a machine you play. Belts add 3 m/s to everything on them, so running with a belt outruns any Drone and running against it is a trap; packs that follow you onto a belt get carried into the pits and the press at its end. Crane STRIKES drop containers (35 HP, 12 RH, then a C crate stays for the rest of the floor), so every few seconds the arena loses a lane and gains a wall: Carapace charges have new walls to stun on, Lancers lose sightlines, and your kiting circle has to change shape. Turrets on the quay pull half the swarm off you while they fire. Split decks joined only by cargo-lift jump pads let you reset a fight by leaving it, but Leapers pounce after you.

floors.events: Teach belts: the two long belts run in opposite directions and both end in a pit. Wave 1 enters from the top corners so it has to cross the east belt. One crane drop per wave, always on an empty lane, with the first one played as a slow 3 s demo (shadow, whine, CLANG). The turret on the north quay is pre-captured for 10 s to show what it does.

floors.params: cart along the rail spur, 400 HP
floors.events: The payload is a reefer container on a flatbed cart (cargo crate model 1.2x on a barrel-chassis). Twist: the crane targets the track. Every 14 s a container lands ON the ':' path ahead of the cart (red circle, 1.5 s) and blocks it until shot down (20 RH, low-priority auto-fire target, explosions x3). Carapaces spawn at the two bends; bait their charges into the blocking containers to stun them and break the box in one go. Capturing the mid-track turret covers the long straight.

Split decks: the UPLINK ring relocates between the west and east decks, so the hero has to take the cargo lifts (jump pads) or the one-way belt gantry across the pit. Leapers pounce across the 2-cell pit after you; Drones have to walk round, so every deck change sheds the pack for 4-5 s. A Shrieker holds the east deck from the second relocation; crane drops now land 2 at a time.

Container Storm: crane drops every 5 s, 2-3 at a time, and the belts reverse at 20 s and 40 s (chevrons flash 1.5 s first). By 60 s the yard is a maze of fresh crates. Both turrets are live; holding one while a Carapace charges it is the floor's big play. Spike at 30 s: a Splitter trio rides the east belt in.

Crusher Bay. Four north-running belts feed the press line on the top row (y), which slams every 6 s with a 1.2 s red flash. The boss is only stunned by walls and containers, and only the press really hurts it, so the fight is about where its charges end.

boss.name: Hullbreaker
boss.body: A dock-hauler Carapace grown to the size of a forklift, plated with the containers it has crushed. Phase 1 (100-60%): Charge Lanes. Yellow lane telegraph (1.0 s), then a charge; a charge that runs WITH a belt goes 1.5x farther, against it 0.5x. Hitting a crate or container stuns it 3.5 s with its soft back exposed. The crane drops 2 containers every 10 s, which are new charge-bait. Phase 2 (60-30%): Lift and Hurl. It rips up the nearest container (1.2 s lift, the box hangs over its head) and hurls it at the hero: a STRIKE circle that leaves a C crate, and each container it breaks releases 4 Ticks. The two turrets come online; it hates them and charges any captured turret, so a captured turret is a lure that turns its back to you. Phase 3 (30-0%): Feed the Press. All belts switch to run north into the press line. A stunned Hullbreaker standing on a belt is carried into the press: 25 RH per slam, and its plating breaks off (front armour gone for 8 s). The counterplay is matador positioning: stand with a container or the press behind you, sidestep at the lock, and let the belt deliver it. Enrage at 15%: two charges back to back.
boss.look: Bloater model at 2.4x, squashed to 0.6x height (the Carapace recipe), tinted rust #7a3b1e with a hazard-yellow #f2c230 emissive strip on the front half; two cargo crate models at 0.35x tinted Hadley teal #1f7a7a bolted on its back as plates (they fall off in Phase 3). Name banner: HULLBREAKER, 'It moves the freight now.'

modifiers: Gale Warning: WIND gusts every 12 s push toward the quay pits; crates give wind shadow.
Overtime: belts run at 5 m/s and reverse every 15 s.
Live Cargo: every crane container cracks open after landing and releases 3 Ticks.
Night Shift: floodlights fail; DARKNESS with light pylons on every crane mast.

rewards.first_clear: Orbital Strike joins this zone's drop pool at double weight (crane-yard flavour), plus +10 Cores.
rewards.replay: Fastest Weapon Parts route of Act II: every crane container destroyed on the ESCORT floor drops 2 Weapon Parts, so quick escort runs are a parts grind.

stars.3: Finish the ESCORT floor with the cart above 50% HP.
stars.bonus: Kill 30 enemies with belts (carried into a pit or the press) in one run.

layout_notes.port-a: Container Yard. Two long opposed belts cut the yard into three strips, each ending in a pit; two turrets on the quays; crate stacks to bait charges.
layout_notes.port-b: Rail Spur. A staircase track crosses the yard on a diagonal from the north-west to the south-east; crate stacks crowd the bends where the Carapaces wait.
layout_notes.port-c: Split Decks. Two decks split by a 2-cell drop, joined by two pairs of cargo lifts and a one-way east belt gantry; four uplink rings alternate decks.
layout_notes.port-boss: Crusher Bay. Press line along the north wall, four belts feeding it, crates mid-field as charge stops, a west belt across the south.
